text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered - metering pipeline detected anomalous token_count deltas for multiple customers. Metric: billing.tokens.delta > 5x baseline for 00:15 window. Alert ID: bill-anom-1927508642. Investigate please.
sre-oncall: ack. I'm online and pulling dashboards (grafana/billing -> tokens.delta). Any customer reports yet?

laura.s: i'm on it too. first glance shows a sharp jump starting at 2026-03-15T14:12Z. Looks correlated with metering-ingest consumer lag.

ajay.k: billing team seeing a flood of overage flags in the queue. Several automated emails queued to customers. Hold on sending any emails until we confirm.

billing-eng: confirmed — queue has ~820 alert messages for customers with <24h usage spikes. We should pause outgoing overage notifications. How to pause?

laura.s: runbook step: disable-alerts for billing-service. command: `POST /admin/alerts/pause` with body `{ "reason": "incident-1927508642" }`

product-ops: can we do a quick customer impact triage — which customers flagged as overage, any high-value ones?

ajay.k: pulling list now. `SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS flags FROM billing_alerts WHERE created_at > '2026-03-15T14:00:00Z' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY flags DESC LIMIT 20;` output shows top 3 include acct_9k, acct_13b, acct_enterprise_omega.

amanda.j: I'll draft a soft-hold customer message if we need it. Prefer to wait until we know it's false positives.

sre-oncall: digging into the producer logs. Found repeated retries from ingest-worker-7 around 14:11Z. Logs show duplicate messages being written to the aggregator with different event_ids but same request_id.
```
[14:11:07Z] ingest-worker-7 INFO processed request_id=abc123 tokens=842
[14:11:07Z] ingest-worker-7 WARN retrying request_id=abc123 due to transient-kafka-error
[14:11:08Z] ingest-worker-7 INFO processed request_id=abc123 tokens=842
```

laura.s: that smells like a transient partition timeout causing at-least-once delivery and our dedupe not catching it. The aggregator uses `event_id` for dedupe; we need request_id dedupe as well.

billing-eng: The aggregator downstream emits a computed 'tokens' metric; if duplicates land, delta job double-counts. Quick check: compare raw inference logs vs billing tokens for a sample request_id.
```
-- SQL snippet
SELECT r.request_id, r.tokens AS raw_tokens, b.tokens AS billed_tokens
FROM raw_inference r
LEFT JOIN billing_aggregate b ON r.request_id = b.request_id
WHERE r.request_id IN ('abc123','def456')
```
Result: raw_tokens=842, billed_tokens=1684 for abc123. Confirmed duplication.

product-ops: ok that's likely cause of overage flags. Next steps? temporary mit?

laura.s: mitigation plan (short):
- pause billing alert dispatch (done via admin endpoint) — ajay/ billing-eng please confirm
- pause aggregation window job for current ingest shard (k8s: `kubectl scale deployment meter-window-worker --replicas=0 --namespace=prod-metering`)
- run a de-dup pass for suspect window (14:00-14:20) using request_id dedupe and re-run delta
- re-enable alerts only after reconciliation

ajay.k: paused alerts (response: 200). Billing emails stopped. :white_check_mark:

billing-eng: scaled meter-window-worker to 0. Confirmed no new aggregate writes from that shard.

sre-oncall: launching one-off de-dupe job. command:
```
python tools/reconcile_dedupe.py --window-start "2026-03-15T14:00:00Z" --window-end "2026-03-15T14:20:00Z" --key-field request_id --dry-run
```
Dry-run shows ~12,400 duplicated entries across shards, estimated excess tokens ~1.2M tokens (affects ~0.6% customers but includes some high-value accounts). Run now?

laura.s: go for it but with throttling and monitoring. Start with shard-7.

billing-eng: reconcile job started on shard-7. Monitoring logs: `reconcile: shard=7 deduped=920 entries reclaimed_tokens=73280`

amanda.j: product wants to put a private note on status page: "Investigating a billing data anomaly affecting alerting. We have paused overage emails while we reconcile counts." Happy to post after you confirm pause.

product-ops: post the note now with PII-safe wording. Include link to status once reconciled.

sre-oncall: quick root-cause summary so far: ingest-worker retry loop + dedupe keyed on event_id only -> duplicate rows in billing_aggregate -> delta window double-counts -> overage alerts. Next: make dedupe use request_id as well and add idempotency in aggregator.

laura.s: creating JIRA 'METER-1321' to track infra fix + upgrade dedupe logic. I'll attach logs and SQL samples.

ajay.k: customers flagged: acct_enterprise_omega is VIP — billing team to run manual check and hold any invoices. Also cc account execs.

billing-eng: full reconciliation running across other shards now. ETA ~35m. Will post progress updates in thread.

Incident Bot: :information_source: Update recorded: incident-1927508642 marked as "investigating". If escalation to P1 required, react with :rotating_light:.

laura.s: quick note for postmortem: we need end-to-end test for dedupe under retry scenarios and a monitor that compares raw_inference totals vs billed_aggregate totals per-window.

amanda.j: product and CS standby for customer comms. If reconciliation reduces billed tokens to within normal variance, we'll send a courtesy note and apologize for false overage flags. If not, we'll prepare remedial credits.

sre-oncall: reconcile progress: 40% complete, reclaimed_tokens so far: 460k. No further duplicates observed after disabling shard-7.

laura.s: thanks team. continuing to monitor; will update here when reconciliation finishes and before re-enabling alert dispatch.

ajay.k: noted. holding all outgoing billing alerts until final confirmation.

billing-eng: reconciliation finished at 1927509420. Total reclaimed_tokens=1,185,340. Suspect window fully reprocessed. Aggregates now match raw_inference counts.

laura.s: verified aggregates vs raw samples — matches. Re-enable meter-window-worker replicas and unpause alerts after 10m observation.

ajay.k: alerts unpaused at 1927509800, but with suppression window to avoid retroactive emails. Will perform manual audit before resuming automated emails.

Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: incident-1927508642 resolved -> Impact: transient duplicate ingestion caused inflated billed tokens and queued overage alerts; mitigation: paused alerts, dedupe/reconcile for affected window, patched runbook. Follow-up: METER-1321, postmortem scheduled.

laura.s: assigning postmortem owners: laura.s (lead), ajay.k (billing), billing-eng (implementation), product-ops (customer comms). Closing thread.
